Set up Turminder

Turminder has two halves: the assistant itself, which runs quietly and holds all your data, and this window, which talks to it. Where should the assistant run?

Starting Turminder

preparing…

Point this app at your Turminder

Ask your assistant to connect this computer and paste the link it answers with below — the line under the QR square. (On a server you have not onboarded yet, turminder token create desktop --qr in the terminal mints the same link.) The key inside it stays on this machine.

Closing this window leaves Turminder in the tray, so reminders still reach you. Use Quit in the tray menu to stop it.
